title: Stasis & Vellum
description: A dark hooded sorcerer with horns stands in pouring rain outside a gothic shop named 'Stasis & Vellum - Spells for the Locked Hour'. He holds a glowing scroll with red arcane script while a massive blue dragon-like creature with glowing orange eyes emerges from the shop interior. The scene is filled with floating skulls, dripping blue potions, lit candles, and ghostly skulls in the stormy sky.
prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy scene of a horned hooded sorcerer in black robes standing in heavy rain at night, holding an unrolled glowing scroll with red magical writing. Behind him a terrifying blue dragon with glowing orange eyes emerges from the open door of a gothic shop called Stasis & Vellum - Spells for the Locked Hour. Floating skulls, dripping blue potion bottles, lit candles, skulls on the ground, stormy atmosphere with ghosts in the sky, highly detailed, moody lighting.
